text:
Alex Kim: Quick heads up — I pushed a draft routing shim that will silently coerce requests without `X-Api-Version` to v2 for a 10% pilot cohort.
Priya Patel: hm — are we sure about silent coercion? quota accounting still tags usage by the old token mapping, so numbers will be skewed.
Alex Kim: good call. The shim doesn't change the token used for billing, just the model selection. I thought telemetry would still show the variant.
Chris O'Neill: telemetry shows model variant in traces, but our billing pipeline looks at `auth.token.owner` mapping which differs between v1 and v2 header paths.
Kelly Wang: this is going to make the console impact preview useless. Users will see v2 latency/cost but billing shows v1 units.
Alex Kim: proposal: add a per-route "compat-mode" flag that emits a synthetic `compat_version` tag into logs and exposes a reconciliation view in Console -> Traffic Insights.
Priya Patel: that helps for debugging, but we need a reconciliation job to post-process metrics for the pilot cohort and surface a delta. Otherwise eng and finance will fight.
Chris O'Neill: I can add a one-off transform: if `compat_mode=true && coerced_to=v2` then map billing_tag -> v2_norm for reports. Low-risk and reversible.
Kelly Wang: UX wise we should expose an "Opt out of silent coercion" toggle in the tenant settings. Some customers want explicit errors not silent switches.
Alex Kim: agreed. Default is pilot ON for existing tenants with low traffic; toggle visible to org owners. Add a tooltip: "Silent coercion routes missing version headers to v2 for compatibility testing. Opt out to get explicit deprecation errors."
Priya Patel: also flag: streaming edge-cases — v1 streaming used chunked framing; v2 uses SSE. Shim swaps the routing but not the transport, so we need to ensure clients don't break mid-stream.
Chris O'Neill: good catch. I'll add a transport compatibility layer that maintains chunked framing when `transport_hint=chunked` is present.
devops-bot: deploy started: `compat/shim/v0.9.1` to canary pool (10%) — containers: 4 -> 4, rolling.
analytics-bot: alert: initial telemetry shows +0.8% token usage divergence for pilot cohort compared to baseline (24h). Investigating whether it's measurement or real.
Kelly Wang: can we get a Console card showing "Pilot reconciliation delta" with links to the transform job and the opt-out toggle? Product wants a screenshot for the 3pm sync.
Alex Kim: yes — I'll add a lightweight card, Chris to wire the API, Kelly to write copy. Priya please own the reconciliation job and postmortem plan if deltas > 2%.
Priya Patel: will do. If we see >2% we'll pause the pilot and flip the cohort to explicit errors. :warning:
Chris O'Neill: tracking tasks: add `compat_mode` tag (done), transport shim (in progress), reconciliation transform (Priya), console card + opt-out toggle (Kelly/Alex). I'll ping when the transport PR is ready for review.
Alex Kim: thanks all. Follow-ups in #eng-platform if anyone hits regressions.
